shellCommands.command: cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && echo "-----" && find .agents -type f | head -100 && echo "-----" && cat AGENTS.md && echo "-----" && ls -la && cat package.json 2>/dev/null

head -80 .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && echo "-----TRAPS" && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md && echo "-----SRC" && find src -type f | xargs -I{} sh -c 'echo "== {}"; cat "{}"' && echo "-----INSTALLED" && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/ && for p in node_modules/@gravity-ui/*/package.json; do node -e "const p=require('./$p');console.log(p.name,p.version)"; done; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head

.agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Table withTableSorting withTableSelection Pagination Checkbox 2>&1 | head -150; echo "-----README"; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/; (curl -sS -m 20 https://gravity-ui.com/llms/uikit/7/llms.txt -o /tmp/uikit7.txt -w "%{http_code}\n" || echo "curl failed")

bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Table withTableSorting withTableSelection Pagination Checkbox 2>&1 | head -150; echo "-----LLMS size"; wc -l /tmp/uikit7.txt; grep -n -i "table\|pagination" /tmp/uikit7.txt | head -80

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && grep -n -i "table\|pagination" README.md | head -30; echo "-----DTS"; ls build | head -50; grep -rl "withTableSorting\|withTableSelection" build --include=*.d.ts | head; echo "----PAG"; grep -rl "export declare const Pagination\|PaginationProps" build --include=*.d.ts | head -5

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && ls Table Table/hoc; echo "-----TABLE INDEX"; cat Table/index.d.ts; echo "-----TABLE TYPES"; cat Table/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null; echo "-----HOC"; cat Table/hoc/withTableSorting/withTableSorting.d.ts Table/hoc/withTableSelection/withTableSelection.d.ts Table/hoc/index.d.ts
cat Table/Table.d.ts; echo "-----PAG"; cat Pagination/Pagination.d.ts; echo "----- index"; cat Pagination/index.d.ts; echo "-----CHECKBOX"; cat Checkbox/Checkbox.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -40
cat Pagination/types.d.ts; echo "-----SORT JS"; cat Table/hoc/withTableSorting/withTableSorting.js | head -150; echo "-----SEL JS"; cat Table/hoc/withTableSelection/withTableSelection.js | head -200

grep -n -A12 "static getRowId" Table/Table.js; echo "-----PAG"; grep -n "page" Pagination/Pagination.js | head -40; echo "-----tsc"; ls /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/.bin | grep -E "^(tsc|vite|vitest)$"; cat /home/sandbox/workspace/tsconfig.json

sed -n 12,30p Pagination/Pagination.js; ls Pagination/utils 2>/dev/null; grep -rn "resultPage\s*=\|const getPaginationItems\|function getPaginationItems" Pagination | head; sed -n 45,52p Table/Table.js

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Pagination && ls utils* 2>/dev/null; f=$(ls utils.js utils/index.js 2>/dev/null | head -1); echo "file=$f"; grep -n -A10 "getResultPage" utils.js 2>/dev/null | head -30 || true; grep -rn -A8 "export const getResultPage\|export function getResultPage" . --include=*.js | grep -v map | head -20

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm && grep -n "Table\|Pagination\|withTable\|Checkbox\|export \* from \"./components/Flex\|Text\|Button" index.d.ts components/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -30; echo "-----FLEX"; sed -n 1,60p components/Flex/Flex.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -60; echo "-----BUTTON VIEW/PROPS"; grep -n "view\|disabled\|size" components/Button/Button.d.ts | head -20; echo "-----TEXT"; grep -n "variant" components/Text/Text.d.ts | head -10

grep -rn "direction\|alignItems\|gap" components/Layout/Flex/*.d.ts components/Flex/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; find . -name "Flex*.d.ts" | head; grep -n "ButtonView\b" -A3 components/Button/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -12; grep -rn "export type ButtonView" components/Button | head -3; grep -n "export type TextVariant\|header-2\|caption-2" -r components/Text/*.d.ts | head -5

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && cat layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts | head -40; echo "-----BV"; cat Button/constants.d.ts | head -30; echo "-----TEXT"; grep -n "variant" Text/Text.d.ts Text/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -8; ls Text
cd /home/sandbox/workspace && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -60; echo "EXIT=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | grep -v "npm warn"; echo "EXIT=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | grep -v "npm warn"; echo "EXIT=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"

ls node_modules | grep -E "^(jsdom|happy-dom|@testing-library)$"; ls node_modules/@testing-library 2>/dev/null; cat .gitignore; echo "-----"; npx vite build 2>&1 | grep -v "npm warn" | tail -15; echo "EXIT=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
git status --short && git diff --stat && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | grep -v "npm warn"; echo "TSC_EXIT=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
